com.datastax.oss.driver.api.testinfra

Annotation Type DseRequirement

  • Deprecated. 
    Replaced by BackendRequirement

    @Deprecated
 @Retention(value=RUNTIME)
public @interface DseRequirement
    Annotation for a Class or Method that defines a DSE Version requirement. If the DSE version in use does not meet the version requirement or DSE isn't used at all, the test is skipped.
